t: A small programmable board for primary schools, inspired by the micro:bit.
steps: Order boards or a class set from the Calliope shop.
Open Calliope Campus or an editor in a browser.
Connect a board by USB or Bluetooth.
Register as a teacher to create rooms.
Read the Calliope mini at School materials.
Note that the materials are aimed at German primary schools.
Run a first program that shows a symbol on the LEDs.
